usage: Organizations should not have too many owners/admins
name: Organizations should not have too many owners/admins
description: Organization or first-level group owners/admins should be relatively small compared to the total number of users.
detailedDescription: An organization or first-level group admin/owner has the authority to create, edit, delete repositories and manage permissions and access to repositories. A compromise of an admin/owner account can be devastating as a result. Therefore, in order to reduce the attack surface it is recommended to reduce the number of admins/owners of an organization or group.

args.name: minAdmins
args.label: Min Admins
args.tooltip: No issue will be created if the number of admins is less than or equal to the value entered.

args.name: minAdminsPercentage
args.label: Min Admin Percent
args.tooltip: No issue will be created if the percentage of admins is less than or equal to the value entered.
